dropped.item: Joan treated the fear as a practical problem 'rather than a character flaw'. The contrast that explains why her approach felt kind is gone.
The restfulness was 'oddly' restful. The sense that this was surprising or unexpected is lost.
The narrator 'didn't feel triumphant so much as' astonished. The explicit rejection of triumph as the feeling is gone.

changed.item: 'Watching eight-year-olds glide past' (the narrator's observation, part of the list of ways she was bad at it) became 'eight-year-olds glided past' (a standalone event). The framing of the narrator's self-conscious watching is slightly softened.
